name: Ascent of the Damned
text: After your creatures attack, they cast Minor Healing, Healing, or Major Healing on themselves.

name: Dark Souls
text: After your creatures Attack, they cast Minor Healing, Healing, or Major Healing on the target.

name: Dead Divinity
text: Enemies' healing spells have 50% more potency.

name: Doomsday
text: After your creatures heal an enemy, they have a 25% chance to cast Ill Fate.

name: Dystopia
text: After an enemy casts a healing spell, each of your creatures have a 5% chance to Cast Shadow Crash.

name: Endwalker
text: If an enemy dies while it is afflicted with Blighted, it cannot be resurrected.

name: Fall From Grace
text: Enemies receive 5% more healing for each time they've been damaged by Blighted in the current battle.

name: Harrow
text: Enemies gain 50% less benefit from stat-boosting effects.

name: Leeches
text: After an enemy attacks, it gains Leeching.

name: Phantom Pain
text: At the start of each enemy's turn, they have a 25% chance to cast Minor Healing on themselves.

name: Self-fulfilling Prophecy
text: After an enemy Casts a spell, it gains Mending.

name: Shadow Mending
text: Your creatures always have Leeching and Mending.

name: Shadow Sickness
text: Enemies always have Blighted.

name: Touch of Darkness
text: After your creatures damage an enemy, the enemy is healed for 20% of the damage dealt.

name: Worldbreaker
text: Enemies take 100% more damage from Blighted.

name: Armor Shred
text: Your creatures' attacks and spells ignore 1% of the enemies' Defense per rank. Maximum Bonus: 25% Defense ignored

name: Barricade
text: When your creatures are Defending, the creatures adjacent to them take 50% less damage.

name: Defensive Stance
text: Your creatures take 5% less damage (up to 90%) for each time they've Defended in the current battle.

name: Explosive Armor
text: After your creatures Defend, they gain 10% Defense and a Barrier that absorbs damage equal to the amount of Defense gained. If the creature already has a Barrier, it explodes, dealing damage to enemies equal to 50% of the Barrier strength.

name: Furious Protector
text: Your creatures always deal critical damage and never dodge.

name: In Formation
text: Your creatures start battles Defending.

name: Last Stand
text: When your creatures take damage that exceeds 100% of their Maximum Health, they have a 50% chance to be left with 1 Health.

name: Lucidity
text: Your creatures are immune to Confused.

name: No Weak Links
text: At the start of battle, your creatures gain Defense equal to 50% of their highest stat.

name: Purge
text: After your creatures Defend, their debuffs are removed and they gain a random buff for each debuff removed.

name: Rest Up
text: After your creatures Defend, their Spell Gems gain 1 Charge.

name: Shield Guard
text: Your creatures gain 100% more benefit from their Artifacts' Stat Slots that increase Defense.

name: The Best Offense
text: Your creatures deal additional damage with attacks and spells equal to 3% of their Defense per rank. Maximum Bonus: 30% of Defense

name: Thorns
text: After your creatures take damage from an attack or spell, they deal damage to enemies equal to 15% of their Defense.

name: Titanic Rage
text: Your creatures deal 150% more damage to enemies that are Defending or Provoking.

name: War Machine
text: After your creatures Provoke, they Defend.

name: Calcify
text: After an enemy takes damage from a spell, they have a 5% chance per rank to be afflicted with Stone. Maximum Bonus: 50% chance

name: Comfortable Proximity
text: When your creatures take damage from an enemy, they take 1% less damage per rank for each creature between the two creatures on the timeline. Maximum Bonus: 10% less damage per creature

name: Fade
text: After your creatures take damage from an attack or spell, they gain Invisible.

name: Flabbergast
text: After your creatures deal damage with attacks or spells to the next enemy below them on the Timeline, that enemy has a 1% chance per rank to be sent to the bottom of the Timeline. Maximum Bonus: 20% chance

name: Gravity's Void
text: When your creatures damage an enemy, they deal 1% more damage per rank for each other creature between the two creatures on the timeline. Maximum Bonus: 15% more damage per creature

name: Mental Fortitude
text: At the start of battle, your creatures gain Shelled.

name: Perplex
text: After an enemy takes damage, they have a 1% chance per rank to be afflicted with Confused. Maximum Bonus: 25% chance

name: Psychic Scream
text: After an enemy Casts a spell, they have a 4% chance per rank to be afflicted with Silenced. Maximum Bonus: 100% chance

name: Ruin
text: Your creatures deal 2% more damage and take 1.5% less damage (up to 90%) for each debuff each enemy has.

name: Singe
text: After an enemy Attacks, they have a 4% chance per rank to be afflicted with Scorned. Maximum Bonus: 100% chance

name: Slipstream
text: After the Timeline is determined at the start of battle, your creatures are moved up the Timeline 1 position higher per rank. Maximum Bonus: 3 positions higher

name: Spell of Frost
text: At the end of an enemy's third turn, they are afflicted with Frozen.

name: Spell of Roots
text: At the end of an enemy's first turn, they are afflicted with Snared.

name: Spell of Slumber
text: At the end of an enemy's second turn, they are afflicted with Sleeping.

name: Undertow
text: At the start of each enemy's turn, they have a 10% chance that your Spell of Roots, Spell of Slumber, and Spell of Frost perks will activate. This chance is increased by an additional 10% each turn. After this perk activates, the chance is set back to 10%.

name: Unity
text: When your creatures deal damage, they deal 2.5% more damage per rank for each consecutive ally that is adjacent to them on the timeline. Maximum Bonus: 20% damage per consecutive ally

name: Attunement
text: Your creatures have 5% more Attack, Intelligence, Defense, and Speed per rank for each Chaos, Sorcery, Death or Nature Infusions you have. Your creatures take 1% less damage per rank for each Life Infusion you have. Maximum Bonus: 25% more stats, 5% less damage per infusion

name: Chaos Infusion
text: After your creatures manually Cast a Chaos spell, you gain 1 Chaos Infusion. When any of your creatures manually Cast a spell, they decrease the enemies' stats by 1% for each Chaos Infusion you have.

name: Chromatic Layering
text: You start battles with 1 Infusion per rank, up to 1 per class. Maximum Bonus: 5 Infusions

name: Chrono Shift
text: After your creatures manually Cast a spell, they also Cast the Spell Gem below it.

name: Death Infusion
text: After your creatures manually Cast a Death spell, you gain 1 Death Infusion. After any of your creatures manually Cast a spell, they afflict enemies with 1 random debuff as long as you have at least 1 Death Infusion, plus 1 additional random debuff for every 3 Death Infusions you have beyond that.

name: Elemental Empowerment
text: Your creatures' spells are 10% more potent per rank for each time your creatures have Cast Colorwave in the current battle. Maximum Bonus: 25% more potency

name: Eternal Echo
text: Your creatures Cast spells 1 additional time per rank. Maximum Bonus: 2 additional casts

name: Infinity
text: After your creatures have collectively Cast Colorwave at least 5 times, they can continue to Cast it for the rest of the battle and it consumes no Infusions.

name: Inspirited Gems
text: Your creatures' "Cast On..." properties have a 1% additional chance per rank to activate. Maximum Bonus: 5% chance

name: Life Infusion
text: After your creatures manually Cast a Life spell, you gain 1 Life Infusion. After any of your creatures manually Cast a spell, they heal your creatures for 10% of their Health for each Life Infusion you have, and gain a Barrier that absorbs damage equal to the amount of Health recovered.

name: Nature Infusion
text: After your creatures manually Cast a Nature spell, you gain 1 Nature Infusion. After any of your creatures manually Cast a spell, their stats are increased by 3% for each Nature Infusion you have.

name: Prismatic Barrier
text: While you have at least 1 Infusion that matches your creatures' classes, those creatures are resistant to debuffs.

name: Sorcery Infusion
text: After your creatures manually Cast a Sorcery spell, they gain 1 Sorcery Infusion. When any of your creatures manually Cast a spell, your creatures gain 1 random buff as long as you have at least 1 Sorcery Infusion, plus 1 additional random buff for every 3 Sorcery Infusions you have beyond that.

name: Spectral Affinity
text: When you gain an Infusion, you gain another Infusion of the type you have the least Infusions of.

name: Temporal Anomaly
text: After your creatures manually Cast a spell, they also Cast the Spell Gem above it.

name: Ultimate Manifestation
text: While you have at least 1 stack of each Infusion, your creatures can Cast Colorwave. After your creatures cast Colorwave, you lose 1 of each Infusion.

name: Addictive Effect
text: Your creatures deal additional damage equal to 4% of the potency of their Poisoned debuff per rank. Maximum Bonus: 20% of poison potency

name: Bioassay
text: Your creatures' spells that interact with Poisoned do not consume Charges.

name: Breath of Death
text: If an enemy dies while it is afflicted with Poisoned, all other enemies take damage equal to 50% of the potency of this debuff.

name: Carcinogen
text: Enemies always have Poisoned.

name: Chronic Illness
text: Your creatures take damage from Poison 1 additional time per rank. Maximum Bonus: 2 extra poison damages

name: Confounding Factors
text: Your creatures' spells that interact with Poisoned have 20% more potency per rank. Maximum Bonus: 100% extra potency

name: Diagnosis
text: Your creatures always have Poisoned. Your creatures can take a maximum of 50% of their Current Health as damage from Poisoned.

name: Dispersing Plague
text: After your creatures take damage from Poison, they have a 20% chance to Cast Virus.

name: Inoculate
text: Your creatures take 10% (up to 80%) less damage from attacks and spells for each time they've taken damage from Poisoned in the current battle.

name: Neurotoxicity
text: Enemies take 1% more damage from attacks and spells for each time each enemy has taken damage from Poisoned in the current battle.

name: Plague of Toads
text: After your creatures Attack, they have a 20% chance to Cast Toxic Frogmania.

name: Prognosis
text: After your creatures take damage from Poisoned, one of your other creatures is healed for the same amount.

name: Side Effects
text: After an enemy takes damage from Poisoned, they are afflicted with a random debuff.

name: Sudden Exposure
text: After your creatures take damage from Poisoned, a random enemy takes this damage as well.

name: Teratogen
text: After a creature takes damage from Poisoned, the potency of all enemies' Poisoned debuffs is increased by 5% per rank. Maximum Bonus: 25% potency boost

name: Toxic Absorption
text: After your creatures take damage from Poisoned, they gain stats (other than Health) equal to 50% of the damage received.

name: Battalion
text: At the start of battle, your creatures gain a random buff for each creature that belongs to the same race fighting on your side. Maximum of 6 buffs.

name: Cogence
text: Your creatures deal 2% more damage per rank to creatures that belong to their own class. Maximum Bonus: 50% more damage

name: Familiarity
text: Your creatures take 2% less damage per rank from creatures that belong to their own class. Maximum Bonus: 50% less damage

name: Feign Death
text: After your creatures are killed, they have a 1% chance per rank to resurrect with 50% Health for each creature that belongs to the same race fighting on your side. Maximum Bonus: 10% chance

name: Fluster
text: Your creatures have an independent 5% chance to dodge attacks for each creature that belongs to the same race fighting on your side.

name: Forest Pact
text: Traits, spells and other effects that are affected by the number of a certain creature race or class act as if you have 1 more of those creatures in your group per rank. Maximum Bonus: Boosted by 3

name: Gone But Not Forgotten
text: Traits, spells and other effects that are affected by the number of a certain creature race or class now work with dead creatures as well.

name: Harbinger
text: Your creatures' Spell Gems with any "Cast On..." property has a 1% greater chance per rank to activate for each creature that belongs to its race fighting on your side. Maximum Bonus: 5% greater chance

name: Hybridization
text: Your creatures have 1% more Attack, Intelligence, Defense and Speed per rank for each creature that belongs to the same race fighting on your side. Maximum Bonus: 5% more stats

name: Overwhelm
text: Your creatures have an independent 5% chance to deal critical damage with attacks for each creature that belongs to the same race fighting on your side.

name: Purebred
text: Your creatures have 1% more Attack, Intelligence, Defense and Speed per rank for each creature that belongs to the same class fighting on your side. Maximum Bonus: 5% more stats

name: Survival Instincts
text: Your creatures take 1% less damage and deal 1% more damage per rank for each dead creature that belongs to the same race fighting on your side. Maximum Bonus: 10% more/less damage

name: Ties That Bind
text: Your creatures deal additional damage with attacks and spells equal to 1% of your other creatures' highest stats per rank that belong to the same race. Maximum Bonus: 5% stat contribution

name: Transformation
text: At the start of battle, your creatures cast their "Morph" spells if they have one of these spells in their top-most Spell Gem slot.

name: Union
text: Your creatures grant 1% of their highest stat per rank to your other creatures that belong to the same race. Maximum Bonus: 10% stat contribution

name: We Are Pack
text: At the start of battle, if you have at least 4 creatures that belong to the same race fighting on your side, the remaining creatures' races are changed to that race as well. This effect does not change a creature's race if it is an Imler.

name: Bafflement
text: At the start of battle, 1 enemy per rank is afflicted with Confused. Maximum Bonus: All six enemies

name: Even the Odds
text: At the start of normal battles, you have a 2% chance per rank to instantly kill a random enemy. If enemies are immune to this effect, they lose 20% of their Current Health instead. Maximum Bonus: 100% chance to kill

name: Feint
text: After your creatures dodge an attack, they have a 4% chance per rank to afflict the enemy with Disarmed. Maximum Bonus: 100% chance to inflict

name: Hidden Hand
text: Your artifacts' Spell Slots have a 2% additional chance per rank to be cast. Maximum Bonus: 15% extra chance

name: Immaculate Recovery
text: When your creatures take damage from an attack or spell, they gain Invisible and Shelled.

name: Intent to Kill
text: When the enemy would dodge your creatures' attacks, the dodge chance is re-rolled one additional time.

name: Nightstalker
text: At the start of battle, one creature in your party gains Invisible per rank, in order from first to last. Maximum Bonus: All creatures become invisible

name: Pilfer
text: At the start of battle, your creatures steal one random Spell Gem per rank from a random enemy. Maximum Bonus: 2 spell gems stolen

name: Prey
text: When your creatures Attack while the target is afflicted with Disarmed, the target's artifact's Stat Slots are applied to your creature for all effects that relate to that attack.

name: Rebound
text: When your creatures Attack, and their attack would fail to deal critical damage, the critical chance is re-rolled one additional time.

name: Sleight of Hand
text: Whenever it is one of your creatures' turns, any random effects that fail to occur are re-rolled an additional time.

name: Spontaneity
text: At random times during battle, your creatures have a 1% chance per rank to cast a random, Ethereal Spell Gem from their spell list.

name: Stratagem
text: Your creatures deal 2% more damage per rank while they're Invisible. Maximum Bonus: 100% extra damage

name: Subterfuge
text: Your creatures' attacks ignore 2% of the target's Defense per rank. Maximum Bonus: 50% defense penetration

name: Tools of the Trade
text: Your artifacts' Trick Slots are 1% more powerful per rank. Maximum Bonus: 25% extra power

name: Whetbone
text: Your creatures always have Proficient.

name: Alpha
text: After your creatures Provoke, they gain Taunting and Protected.

name: Awareness
text: After your creatures Defend, they gain Defensive and Rebirth.

name: Bristle
text: After your creatures take damage from a spell, they gain Repelling and Shelled.

name: Convocation
text: After your creatures Cast a spell, they gain Arcane.

name: Earthen Frenzy
text: After your creatures gain a buff, they have a 2% chance per rank to Attack a random enemy. Maximum Bonus: 20% chance

name: Eternal Guardian
text: Your creatures' buffs persist through death.

name: Graceful Spirit
text: At the start of your creatures' turns, they gain a Barrier that absorbs damage equal to 1% of their Maximum Health per rank. Maximum Bonus: 25% of Maximum Health

name: Grove Ward
text: After your creatures lose stats, they gain Warded.

name: Luster
text: After your creatures take damage from an attack, they gain Agile and Mending.

name: Moment of Clarity
text: After your creatures gain a buff, they have a 2% chance per rank to Cast one of their spells. Maximum Bonus: 20% chance

name: Nature's Boon
text: Your creatures have 1% more stats (other than Health) per rank for each buff they have. Maximum Bonus: 10% more stats

name: Overrun
text: After your creatures gain a buff, they recover 3% Health per rank. Maximum Bonus: 30% Health recovered

name: Predator
text: After your creatures Attack, they gain Splashing and Savage.

name: Preparation
text: At the start of battle, your creatures gain Invisible and Proficient.

name: Primal Vengeance
text: After one of your creatures are killed, all your creatures gain Berserk and Leeching.

name: Soul of the Forest
text: After your creatures gain a buff, they gain 2% per rank of a random stat. Maximum Bonus: 20% stat gain

name: Spirit Shield
text: Your creatures deal 2% more damage per rank and take 1% less damage per rank for each buff they have. Maximum Bonus: 10% more damage, 5% less damage

name: Survival of the Fittest
text: After your creatures gain a buff and they already have at least 7 other buffs, they gain Immune.

name: Unending Boon
text: Your creatures' buffs last forever. In addition, when one of your creature's buffs would be forcefully removed (for example, if your creature with Invisible makes an action), they have a 30% chance to retain that buff.

name: Accumulation
text: At the start of your creatures' turns, they gain 1% Speed per rank, plus additional Speed equal to 1% per rank of the amount of Speed they've gained in the current battle. Maximum Bonus: 5% Speed

name: Aeroforged
text: Your creatures gain 3% more benefit from their Artifacts' Stat Slots per rank, other than Health. Maximum Bonus: 30% more benefit

name: Born Again
text: After your creatures are killed from start-of-battle effects, they are resurrected with 50% Health.

name: Derivation
text: After your creatures gain stats other than Speed, they gain Speed equal to 3% of the amount gained per rank. Maximum Bonus: 15% of the amount

name: First Served
text: After the order of the Timeline is determined at the start of battle, your creatures are moved up the Timeline 1 position higher per rank. Maximum Bonus: 3 positions higher

name: Further Beyond
text: Increases your creatures' maximum stat limits before they are subjected to diminishing returns by 10% per rank. Maximum Bonus: 100% higher limit

name: Inertia
text: Your creatures cannot lose stats.

name: Primordial
text: Your creatures' Nether Stones are 5% more powerful per rank. This perk does not affect a Nether Stone's traits, spells, or any Trick Slots that increase a creature's maximum number of Spell Gem slots. Maximum Bonus: 50% more power

name: Propulsion
text: Your creatures take 1% less damage per rank (up to 90%) for every 100% Speed they have greater than their base Speed. Maximum Bonus: 10% less damage

name: Quick Hands
text: Your creatures are immune to Disarmed.

name: Retention
text: Your creatures' stats are no longer reset after they're killed.

name: Sidestep
text: If your creatures' Speed is greater than 200% of their base Speed, they are resistant to debuffs.

name: Singleton
text: Enemies can only Attack and Cast spells once at a time.

name: True Ending
text: All creatures' on-death effects are ignored. This perk does not affect the Born Again perk. This perk does not work in boss battles.

name: Velocity
text: Your creatures' attacks and spells deal 3% of their damage per rank using Speed instead of Attack or Intelligence. Maximum Bonus: 30% of speed

name: Zoom
text: Your creatures always dodge. The first time your creatures Attack in battle, they have a 100% chance to deal critical damage.

name: Backbite
text: Enemies have a 100% greater chance to deal critical damage to their allies.

name: Bad Medicine
text: At the start of battle, your creatures gain Secret Stuff.

name: Bewitch
text: After an enemy Attacks one of its allies, your creatures gain a random buff.

name: Blind Eye
text: Enemies cannot dodge attacks from their allies.

name: Cursed Omen
text: Enemies Attack and Cast spells on their allies 1 additional time.

name: Hedge Magic
text: Enemies take 10% more damage per rank from their allies. Maximum Bonus: 100% more damage

name: Hex
text: Enemies with Confused have a 5% chance per rank to lower their allies' stats instead of increasing them. Maximum Bonus: 50% chance

name: Initiation Rite
text: When an enemy Attacks one of its allies, its highest stat is used to determine the damage dealt.

name: Jinx
text: Enemies always have Cursed.

name: Maledict
text: Enemies take additional damage equal to 5% of the damage they've taken from their allies in the current battle per rank. Maximum Bonus: 15% of taken damage

name: Mass Hysteria
text: After an enemy takes damage from an ally, they are afflicted with Blind and Confused.

name: Mumbo Jumbo
text: Enemies with Confused have a 5% chance per rank to afflict allies with a debuff instead of a buff. Maximum Bonus: 50% chance

name: Terrorize
text: After an enemy Attacks one of its allies, it afflicts the target with a random debuff.

name: Trance
text: After your creatures Attack, they have a 5% chance per rank to Cast Mind Control on the target. Maximum Bonus: 25% chance

name: Vision Quest
text: At the start of battle, your creatures gain Doppelganger.

name: Voodoo
text: When an enemy Casts a spell on one of its allies, its highest stat is used to determine the potency of the spell.
